name: final_dynamics_v1
trace_definition: stimulus vector -> EmoNet neural dynamics -> tick-by-tick neuron activation trajectory -> branch tensor/z summary
selection_reason: Passes the collapse constraint on the full 80-sample validation set: len1_ratio = 0.0875.
Reduces overactivation relative to persistent_less_inhibition: density 0.839878 vs 0.947035.
Keeps a long enough recurrent trace: mean_dominant_branch_len = 33.2375.
Retains positive branch_mean geometry on valence, social_orientation, action_tendency_class, and appraisal_family.
Chosen over thr0.70_topk3_clip1.2_inh0.18 because that candidate has lower density but fails the collapse target: len1_ratio = 0.1125.
known_limitations: The current runtime does not provide scikit-learn, so the exporter used the stat/fallback stimulus vector path rather than the learned text encoder path.
The z summary remains weak; branch_mean is the stronger probe representation.
Target/blame direction is not yet robustly encoded.
Density is improved but still slightly above the preferred sparse target of 0.80.
